source.title: Notch Is Required for Neural Progenitor Proliferation During Embryonic Eye Regrowth

intervention.description: Eye-ablated embryos injected in the left dorsal blastomere at four-cell stage with GFP and dexamethasone-inducible NICD mRNA, treated with 20 nM concanamycin A without dexamethasone after surgery.
